5\. Nested builders miss a playbook warning 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
_owner_warning joins the repository-relative configured playbook path to its repo argument, but
daemon-side kit filing passes the builder's working directory rather than the repository root. When
that directory is below the root and the kit changes a custom-path playbook, the check looks beneath
the directory twice and can omit the warning that the current autonomous playbook requires human
ownership.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The configured playbook path includes the builder directory's Git prefix, while daemon-side checks use that directory as their repository argument. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/hands/kit.py[877-889] - src/hands/kit.py[909-918] - src/hands/api.py[823-827] ## Recommended Fix Resolve the repository-relative configured path against the actual Git root, or derive a path relative to the supplied check directory. Cover a builder cwd below the root with a configured custom playbook path. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
